fields.statement: At 20626479 (fakes only): go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestBuiltin passes, incl. TestBuiltinPlanMilestone (plan-milestone loads, Start and Steps DeepEqual plan's, every stage autonomy owner). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-milestone-workflow|workflow-ls|daemon-milestone-request|plan-workflow-autonomous|run-autonomy-source)$' passes: with fake rex and rhiza.autonomy.plan auto, workflow ls lists plan-milestone as builtin:plan-milestone, the milestone dry-run reports workflow plan-milestone sourced from the workflow and not autonomous, the daemon detaches run start --workflow plan-milestone ... --milestone with no --autonomous, and a repo .rhiza/workflows/plan-milestone.toml declaring autonomous = true makes the daemon pass --autonomous even with plan owner. Read internal/api: daemonStartPlan/planRunArgs carry no hard-coded milestone rule (requestPick swaps plan for plan-milestone; milestonePlanWorkflow swaps it for run start --milestone and record change sets via planIsMilestone, journaling resolveWorkflow's builtin:plan-milestone path).
